cohort: Women with a history of pelvic ring injury who subsequently underwent pregnancy and delivery
finding: Vaginal delivery is possible after pelvic ring injury, and while retained trans-iliosacral implants did not affect delivery outcome, residual pelvic asymmetry was associated with an increased risk of caesarean section.
mod_finding: Residual pelvic asymmetry after pelvic ring injury, as measured by the Lefaivre criteria, is a potential risk factor for Caesarean section.
